sources.snippet: In general, one means keep first model, zero means keep second model For DARE, we use the base model to determine which values to protect or include. For TIES, we can use the sum of the delta ties (as in the paper), or the count, or off to disable. Can accept a model mask, which will restrict changes to only modify the masked areas.
